checks.name: UEFI Secure Boot
checks.description: Is Secure Boot enabled and strictly enforcing signed bootloaders?
checks.remediation: Enter BIOS/UEFI -> Boot -> Secure Boot -> Enabled. Reinstall OS if switching from Legacy.

checks.name: TPM 2.0 Status
checks.description: Is the Trusted Platform Module active, provisioned, and owning platform keys?
checks.remediation: Enter BIOS/UEFI -> Security -> TPM -> Enable & Activate. Run 'Initialize-Tpm' in PowerShell.

checks.name: Core Isolation / VBS
checks.description: Is Virtualization-Based Security running to protect memory?
checks.remediation: Enable in BIOS: Intel VT-x/AMD-V. Then: Windows Security -> Device Security -> Core Isolation -> On.

checks.name: DMA Protection
checks.description: Is Kernel DMA Protection enabled against malicious Thunderbolt/USB/PCIe devices?
checks.remediation: Enable via Group Policy: Computer Config -> Admin Templates -> System -> Kernel DMA Protection -> Enabled.

checks.name: Firmware Updates
checks.description: Are BIOS/UEFI versions patched against known Intel ME / AMD PSP vulnerabilities?
checks.remediation: Check motherboard manufacturer support site for BIOS updates. Apply latest firmware patch.

checks.name: BitLocker / Device Encryption
checks.description: Is the OS drive encrypted with XTS-AES 256?
checks.remediation: Run: 'manage-bde -on C:' as Admin. Or: Control Panel -> BitLocker Drive Encryption -> Turn On.

checks.name: Boot Configuration Data (BCD)
checks.description: Is testsigning and debug mode strictly disabled?
checks.remediation: Run: 'bcdedit /set testsigning off' and 'bcdedit /set debug off' as Admin.

checks.name: Early Launch Anti-Malware (ELAM)
checks.description: Are ELAM drivers verified before standard boot drivers?
checks.remediation: ELAM is driver-loaded; ensure Secure Boot is enabled. No user toggle needed on modern Windows.

checks.name: SMM (System Management Mode)
checks.description: Are SMM protections active against firmware rootkits?
checks.remediation: SMM protection is firmware-level. Ensure BIOS is updated to latest version from manufacturer.

checks.name: Hardware Virtualization
checks.description: Is VT-x/AMD-V enabled for hardware-backed sandboxing?
checks.remediation: Enter BIOS/UEFI -> CPU Configuration -> Intel VT-x/AMD SVM -> Enabled. Reboot.
